request.name: Fix ChatView.vue - Sidebar expand on click anywhere & Subtask inheritance
request.description:
## ChatView.vue Issues

### Issue 1: Sidebar Expand on Click
- The sidebar must expand when clicking anywhere (not just on a specific button)
- Currently sidebar may only expand on dedicated expand button or limited clickable area
- Need to make entire sidebar clickable area responsive to expand action

### Issue 2: Subtask Inheritance  
- When creating a subtask, it must inherit `project_id` and `profiles` from parent task
- Ensure subtask creation form is populated with parent's project_id
- Ensure subtask creation form is populated with parent's profiles
- This prevents data loss and maintains task hierarchy integrity

## Acceptance Criteria
- ✅ Sidebar expands on click anywhere within the sidebar area
- ✅ Subtask creation inherits project_id from parent
- ✅ Subtask creation inherits profiles from parent
- ✅ No regression in existing functionality

request.name: Refactor Chat.vue - Use Collapsible for File list & profiles
request.description:
## Chat.vue Refactoring

Use Collapsible component for better UX with truncated headers and expandable details.

### Requirements

#### File List
- [ ] Replace current File list display with Collapsible component
- [ ] In header view: show truncated file count/preview only
- [ ] In detail view: show full expanded file list
- [ ] Implement smooth expand/collapse animation

#### Profiles List
- [ ] Apply same Collapsible pattern to profiles
- [ ] Truncate in header view (show count or first few profiles)
- [ ] Full list in detail/expanded view
- [ ] Maintain profile selection functionality

#### General Lists in Header
- [ ] Apply collapsible pattern to other relevant lists in header
- [ ] Ensure consistent UI/UX across all list components
- [ ] Preserve all existing functionality

## Acceptance Criteria
- ✅ File list uses Collapsible component
- ✅ Profiles use Collapsible component  
- ✅ Truncation works in header mode
- ✅ Expansion works in detail mode
- ✅ All lists properly collapse/expand
- ✅ No data loss during interactions

request.name: Fix MainMenu - List all apps & add single view routes
request.description:
## MainMenu Issues

### Issue: App List & Routing

#### Current State
- MainMenu may not list all available apps
- Missing or incomplete routes for single app view
- Desktop view may be interfering with single view routing

#### Requirements
- [ ] List ALL apps available in the system
- [ ] Ensure each app has a dedicated single view route
- [ ] Remove or deprioritize desktop view
- [ ] Maintain app navigation consistency

#### App Discovery & Routes
- [ ] Audit current app list in MainMenu
- [ ] Verify all apps have corresponding single-view routes
- [ ] Create missing routes as needed
- [ ] Update MainMenu to display all apps
- [ ] Test navigation to each single-view app

## Acceptance Criteria
- ✅ All apps listed in MainMenu
- ✅ Each app has working single-view route
- ✅ No desktop-only apps blocking single view access
- ✅ Navigation between apps works smoothly
- ✅ Routes are RESTful and consistent
